IRON KITCHEN
NUTRITIONAL
INFORMATION
TOTAL
CALORIES: 812
CARBS: 64G
FATS: 15G
PROTEIN: 98G
45 MIN
LOADED PROTEIN
BEEF NACHO
BAKE
INGREDIENTS
(Base)
• 150g Corn Tortilla Chips (Brand:
any baked chips -
low fat is best)
• 200g Low Fat Cottage
Cheese
• Chili Powder, Salt &
Cumin
(Topping)
• 250g Lean Beef
Mince
• 40g Light / Low Fat Cheese
(Brand: any 50% less fat
grated cheese)
• 1/2 Diced Medium Red
Onion
• Fresh Coriander
DIRECTIONS
• 1. Spread the chips in a baking dish and spoon the
cottage cheese over the top.
• 2. Brown the beef with the chili powder, salt and
cumin, then spread it over the
chips.
• 3. Top with cheese and onion and bake at 200 degrees
celsius for 10 minutes.

#9
